title: Draw in-flight workers in a widget below the editor
action: Draw a widget with ui.setWidget(<key>, factory, { placement: "belowEditor" }) listing in-flight workers, sourced from the pending markers already in .bee/result-inbox/<token>/ (D2). Re-render on the drain's existing setInterval tick at bee-guard.ts:965 — add no second timer (claim 15). One row per marker, rendering its seat, or '<seat> · <cell_id>' when the marker carries cell_id, never the raw job_id; fall back to the job id's short suffix when neither field is present. Rows carry only the tick glyph for in-flight work (D5). Remove a row the moment its marker clears, and do not draw the widget at all when no markers exist (D3). Take no input (D4). Advisory posture: an absent or unreadable inbox draws nothing and never throws. Add contract fixtures and a pi-runtime.md sub-feature row. Rebuild the binary so doctor's byte-compare agrees (D9). REGEN OBLIGATION: .pi/extensions is a release-manifest-hashed root, so run the full chain inside THIS cell before capping — bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order) — and commit the refreshed release-manifest.json with the change.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: A dispatched detached worker appears as a row naming its seat
The row disappears once that worker's marker clears
No widget is drawn when no workers are in flight

key_links: the widget reads the same inbox directory the drain polls
prohibitions: No second timer or polling loop
No row kept after its worker finishes
No raw job_id shown as a row's label

checks.evidence: The commit adds a setWidget factory keyed IN_FLIGHT_WORKERS_WIDGET_KEY with { placement: "belowEditor" } (9 added lines match setWidget|belowEditor), sourced from the result-inbox pending markers. D2 satisfied without any component library or vendored panel code.

setWidget(IN_FLIGHT_WORKERS_WIDGET_KEY, undefined) is the clear path — Pi 0.85.1 extensions.md documents the undefined third argument as 'Clear'. Rows derive from live markers, so a cleared marker removes its row (D3).
The same undefined-clear call is taken when no markers exist, so the widget is not drawn at all rather than drawn empty (D3).

Re-run by the leader: .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check -> '376 file(s) match stored manifest, 1 unhashed artifact(s) present', exit 0. release-manifest.json moved in the commit and .bee/bin/bee was rebuilt, so the regen chain was actually run.
Searched the added lines for setInterval|setTimeout — 0 matches. The widget rides the drain's existing unref'd timer at bee-guard.ts:965, which was claim 15 in the plan.
No onKey or onInput surface added; the widget is informational only (D4).

formatWorkerRow(marker) renders '<seat> · <cell_id>' when both are present, seat alone, or cell_id alone, and falls back to the job id's SHORT SUFFIX only when the marker carries neither — never the raw job-1789899558831-338879-1 form. This implements the sparse-marker case that came out of the hat-user-impact finding.

Only the tick glyph appears in added rows; no unreachable success/failure glyphs were invented (D5). git show 0d32a4a6e --stat lists exactly the 4 declared files — herding/wave.rs, .claude/, .codex-plugin/ and .opencode/ are all untouched (D10).
